Tata Sons Chairman N. Chandrasekaran's Succession Process Initiated

N. Chandrasekaran is reportedly preparing to step down as Chairman of Tata Sons, the holding company of the Tata Group. The Sir Dorabji Tata Trust has passed a resolution to establish a selection committee to recommend a successor. This development intensifies focus on succession planning and a potential stock market listing for Tata Sons. The Tata Trusts have stated they will nominate no joint representative for the Tata Sons AGM.
